messages:
jia: noticed CI rerank job flaky — NDCG@10 swings by ~0.04 between identical commits in rerank/integration job. Started failing on rs-20260110-7.
ashwin: logs? stack traces?
jia: excerpt from CI: 

FAIL: rerank_e2e_test (tests.rerank.TestRerank)
AssertionError: NDCG@10 mismatch: expected >= 0.612, got 0.568
Pipeline run id: rs-20260110-7

ben-s: i can repro locally but only when using faiss index with nprobe=8. with nprobe=1 it's stable. suspect nondet in faiss threading.
maria: faiss multithread nondeterminism is a thing. what's OMP_NUM_THREADS in the CI image?
ashwin: CI image exports OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 by default. my dev box is 1. That could explain some variability.
jia: we also added an embedding quantization step in the runner (int8) for the experiment. int8->float roundtrip might introduce tiny scale changes.
ashwin: so two axes: faiss threading nondet, and quantization-induced numeric drift. which one is root cause?
ben-s: did a quick ablation — disable quantize but keep nprobe=8: metric stabilizes. keep quantize but set nprobe=1: still flaky. points to quantization as main cause.
maria: check normalization. our pipeline expects L2-normalized embeddings when adding to FAISS. any normalization after dequantize?
jia: current harness snippet: 
``
# runner snippet
emb = quantize_to_int8(emb_raw)
emb = dequantize(emb)
# no explicit l2_norm here
idx.add(embs)
```
maria: aha — missing l2_normalize post-dequantize. int8 roundtrip changes vector scale a bit, so neighbor rankings shift.
ashwin: simple fix: l2_normalize after dequantize, and set FAISS threads to 1 in CI to eliminate threading nondet. also add deterministic tie-breaking in metric aggregation.
ben-s: will add: (1) l2_norm after dequantize in harness, (2) OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 in rerank CI job, (3) --eval-seed=42 exported to runner. also add deterministic stable sort by (score, id) when computing NDCG to avoid tie reordering.
jia: can we add a unit test: quantize->dequantize->l2_norm results within epsilon of original normalized vector (cosine diff < 1e-4)?
ashwin: yes, and a tiny smoke eval in CI (small dataset) to catch regressions quickly.
maria: I'll open PR with the harness patch and the test. calling out quantization caveats in PR description for model onboarding docs.
ben-s: metrics-service currently returns median over runs. that hides bimodal/flaky runs. i'll add stddev + sample count and a flakiness flag for a dataset-model pair.
jia: add a dashboard note: daily report should surface run-to-run variance and mark flaky runs so owners can triage.
jeval-bot: quick rerun (rs-20260110-7) with l2_norm + OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 => NDCG@10 = 0.613, passes.
richard: thanks for quick triage, team. pls add an eng-ml runbook entry on faiss nondeterminism + CI recommendations (OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, determinism checklist for quantize).
ashwin: assigning deterministic-sort test to myself. i'll land after CI smoke passes.
maria: PR numbers: #891 harness l2_norm + test; #892 metrics-service stddev + flakiness flag. leaving notes in PR about impact on model onboarding and quantization guidance for future off-ramps.
ben-s: one more: add a comment in the eval harness docs about preferred order: normalize -> quantize -> dequantize -> normalize (defensive).
jia: good. will write short runbook snippet and put in eng-ml/infra.
richard: tagging for visibility. nice triage and follow-ups.
